depositId.description: Transaction UUID of the refunded deposit

currency.description: Currency name. `null` if the currency was removed after the refund.

ticker.description: Currency [ticker](/glossary#ticker). `null` if the currency was removed after the refund.

network.description: Deposit network. `null` if the currency was removed after the refund.

refundHash.description: Blockchain transaction hash of the refund. `null` unless `status` is `successful`.

memo.description: Destination [memo](/glossary#memodestination-tag) sent in the [refund request](/api-reference/account-wallet/refund-deposit). `null` if no memo was sent.

status.description:
Refund status:
- `in_process` — the refund is not final. Every non-final state maps to this value.
- `successful` — the refund is complete.
- `canceled` — the refund is canceled. Final.

createdAt.description: Refund creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds

processedAt.description: Time the refund reached its current status, Unix timestamp in seconds. `null` while `status` is `in_process`.
